lookalikes.ct.description: Registered lookalikes of your domains are looked up in crt.sh to see whether they hold certificates. Turn this off to keep those names private; lookalikes are then checked through DNS only.
lookalikes.ct.title: Certificate checks of lookalike domains
lookalikes.empty: Watch one of your root domains to find lookalikes registered by others.
lookalikes.emptyReview: No registered lookalike in this state.
lookalikes.pageDescription: Domains registered by others that imitate yours, found without contacting them.
lookalikes.removeDesc: Its open lookalike exposures are resolved and its candidates are dropped.
lookalikes.removeFailed: Could not stop watching the domain
lookalikes.reviewDescription: Domains registered by someone that imitate yours. Mail servers or a certificate make phishing more likely.
lookalikes.watchesDescription: Your root domains (a permanent domain scope entry or a verified domain) and their lookalikes. Checks are passive: DNS lookups and Certificate Transparency, daily for registered lookalikes and weekly for the rest. No lookalike host is contacted.
lookalikes.maxInvalid: Enter a whole number from 10 to 1000
